messages:
sara: heads-up: seeing p99 spikes on canary after today's runtime deploy (deploy/2026-03-18 14:12 UTC). p95 steady, tails blow up.

alex: what's the delta? numbers?

sara: baseline p99 ~120ms, canary at 420-600ms on short seq workloads. throughput looks fine. cpu/gpu not saturated.

tim: did the deploy touch kernel selector or batching heuristics?

sara: yes — autotune heuristic change: prefer dense-kernel for small batch density. config in PR #4893:
```yaml
kernel_selector:
  prefer_dense_for_small_sequences: true
  microbatch_threshold: 16
batcher:
  min_microbatch: 1
  max_microbatch: 32
kv_cache:
  prefetch_pages: 2
```

matt: kv_cache.prefetch_pages was increased in that PR? we reverted earlier tests but maybe it got merged.

sara: profiler traces indicate longer mutex wait on kv cache during prefix hits. here's excerpt (simplified):
```
waits: kv-cache-lock 120ms -> 340ms
kernel-switch-cost 0.8ms -> 1.5ms
queue-depth spikes at microbatch boundaries
```

alex: sounds like prefetch + kernel switch is creating short stalls that amplify tails. can we confirm on canary pods? logs show repeated cache misses then bursts of reload.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T14:12Z applied to canary group 'crystal' (3 pods).

sara: repro script:
```bash
ab -n 1000 -c 8 -p short-seq.json http://canary/predict
```

tim: propose immediate rollback of the kernel-selector heuristic and prefetch bump on canary. if p99 drops we roll full back. agree?

matt: +1. prepping revert PR.

alex: also add quick metric: kv-cache-lock-duration p99 and kernel-switch-count per-request in dashboards.

matt: PR #4897 created to revert autotune change and set prefetch_pages=0. applying to canary now.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T14:18Z applied to canary group 'crystal' (3 pods) — release revert/4897.

sara: post-revert numbers: p99 back to 130-150ms within 90s of rollout, kv-cache-lock p99 down to 140ms.

tim: nice. do a gradual canary -> prod rollback after smoke.

alex: open follow-up ticket for root cause: interaction between kernel selection, microbatch density, and prefetch locking. assign to eng-runtime/alloc team.

sara: captured flamegraph and perf profile, attaching in thread (link: https://perf.internal/reports/1850012345). note: microbatch boundary transitions show double-locks when prefetch races with kernel selection.

matt: leaving note in changelog and add integration test for prefix-hit heavy workloads.

sara: thanks all. lessons: small microbatch thresholds + aggressive prefetch can increase contention; prefer conservative defaults until we have lock-free prefetch.

oncall: incident resolved, will monitor for 2h. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: alert suppressed for 'canary-p99' for 30m.

alex: nice fast rollback. follow-up: add synthetic canary that stresses short-seq + prefix pop pattern.

sara: created ticket RW-1724, assigned to tim+alex. closing thread.
